title.native: クロックワーク・プラネット

description:
Naoto's a high school dropout and brilliant amateur tinkerer. He lives in a world that has been so over-exploited that the entire surface has become one vast machine. When a box crashes into his home containing a female automaton, it's a harbinger of change that will rock the entire globe, and give Naoto his chance to be a hero.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

node.description:
__Race:__ Automata

As described by Naoto, RyuZU has soft and smooth silver hair, snow white skin, golden eyes, and lithe arms and legs. She wears a simple, elegant black and purple dress, and a hair ornament made from white gears and a cloth with red, green and black color. She also has two black scythes made from gears hidden in her back.
While in her special mode, her clothes turns into a tight-fitting crystal-colored wedding veil and her golden eyes change into a blazing ruby. 

Like her code name (Yourslave) implies, she is an automata made to serve her master - in this case, Naoto.
Since she does not have an offensive language filter installed within her, she tends to be very rude to others, although she is oblivious to this.
Unlike most automata, she possesses her own free will, and genuinely wants to stay by her master's side.

(Source: Clockwork Planet Wiki)

Naoto is obsessed with clockwork and is often oblivious to his surroundings. Due to this, he is often bullied in school.

Naoto prefers automata over humans as automata do not age.  ~! He even called Marie a "flesh-bag" and refused her request to help her fix Kyoto's Core Tower. He only accepted after RyuZU told him that her younger sister (AnchoR) is located there. !~

He isn't the kind of person to be angered easily. Despite being bullied by his classmates (and at times being scorned, or humiliated), he doesn't seem to mind it at all.

(Source: Clockwork Planet Wiki)
AnchoR is RyuZU's youngest sister and the 4th unit of the Initial Y-Series.

name.native: マリー・ベル・ブレゲ

node.description:
Marie is a mature young girl for her age who takes things very seriously, especially in her work.

Due to her genius intellect, she and others believe her to be the one smartest clockmaker in history, and would shoot down anyone who interrupts her.  Despite this, she is able to work as a team player and works well with the rest of the Meister Guild, effectively fixing many problems faced.

She doesn't seem to care about her high status and would easily throw away her Meister title in order to fake her own death. Like Naoto, she takes pride in her work and would sometimes argue with those who criticize it.

(Source: Clockwork Planet Wiki)

name.native: ヴァイネイ・ハルター

node.description:
Halter is a generally friendly person who is seldom angered. He is very loyal to Marie.

~! He is an 8th generation mechanized human. This makes his strength far beyond that of any ordinary human. !~

(Source: Clockwork Planet Wiki)
